model Definition
model Definition · 5 fields
margin
EBIT after ongoing SBC, depreciation and R&D, before interest; no automatic non-GAAP EBITDA substitution
sales To Capital
Incremental revenue / net operating reinvestment, not revenue / gross capital spending
tax
Normalized cash tax rate on positive operating profit; model existing losses/NOLs separately, no cash tax benefit for losses without realizability
stable Reinvestment
g / terminal ROIC of NOPAT; terminal capital efficiency reconciled with margin/tax
sales To Capital Fade
After the explicitly specified capital-efficiency years, fade linearly to terminal ROIC / [terminal EBIT margin × (1 − normalized tax)] by the last forecast year.

wacc Status
Scenario judgment; not estimated market beta/spread. Growth-company operating and financing risk warrant explicit sensitivity, not false precision.
formula
Cost of equity = USD risk-free + assumed beta × chosen ERP; WACC also depends on debt weights/cost and normalized tax. No current beta or debt spread measured.
valuation Gates
valuation Gates · 5 records
  1. Reconcile current fully diluted shares and employee awards; June balance and August shares are not October cash/share roll-forward.
  2. Subtract noncontrolling economic claim once; review SiC restricted cash and contingent arrangements rather than treating all cash as unrestricted.
  3. Series B preferred already converted: do not deduct old preferred claim and include converted shares simultaneously.
  4. Explicit working capital and capex bridge required; FY2026 operating cash flow only $79.5m despite EBITDA growth.
  5. FY2027 started before the cutoff. Model the October 17 valuation stub and avoid discounting an entire already-started fiscal year as if wholly future.
uncertainties
uncertainties · 3 records
  1. $3bn quarter is a call expectation, not an FY2027 revenue guarantee.
  2. Current growth partly reflects AI demand and capacity scarcity; industrial revenue fell.
  3. Terminal ROIC 12% is a judgment, not proven consolidated through-cycle return; acquired goodwill/intangibles make reported ROIC definition-sensitive.
not Used
not Used · 4 records
  1. Current share price as calibration target
  2. Unverified consensus forecasts
  3. Unwatched video claims

double Counting Rule
Amounts overlap across principal/carrying/fair value, cash/financing, RPO/customer contracts, or rent/capitalized leases. Use mutually consistent treatments.
integration Policy
Use source-date balances only after reconciling operating cash, investments, debt/lease policy, post-balance events and share/award treatment. An unresolved value is null, not zero. A future economic funding deficit is an outcome, not additional face-value debt.

rationale
rationale · 10 fields
growth
25% is near FY2026 growth of 22.5% and below the latest 34% reported quarter. AI optics supports expansion; industrial exposure and eventually normalizing customer investment require a fade.
target Margin
20% improves on FY2026 GAAP EBIT margin of 12.6% through utilization, mix and integration. It is an EBIT assumption after ongoing compensation and depreciation, not a non-GAAP gross-margin target.
tax
24% normalizes the very low FY2026 effective rate and prior loss-related volatility; acquisition and restructuring tax effects are not extended indefinitely.
sales Capital
1.25x implies $0.80 of net investment for each incremental $1 of sales. Vertical manufacturing, capacity and working capital remain important even if acquired capacity improves utilization.
terminal ROIC
12% assumes moderate enduring photonics know-how benefits but much less than current high-growth incremental economics.
wacc
10.5% nominal USD is a rounded model estimate. Assumed beta 1.5, 20% target debt and a 2.5-point spread reflect optical/industrial cyclicality and a more levered acquisition history.
terminal Growth
2.5% nominal USD is a mature-state assumption with limited real expansion, well below the high-growth starting rate and the discount rate; it is not a company forecast.
years
10 years is the common model horizon so company economics can be compared; rates and margins fade over this period. The number is a modeling convention, not a source fact.
other Claims
0 is an unreviewed placeholder, not evidence that no additional claims exist. Review preferred securities, minority interests and debt terms; acquisition accounting and claims cannot be inferred from a historical book-capital ratio.
other Assets
0 is an unreviewed placeholder, not a statement that all non-operating assets are absent or worthless. Review assets not already included in snapshot cash and avoid double counting.
